image_description: A close-up, front-facing view of a single circular loudspeaker driver (woofer) with a grey metallic or plastic frame and a dark grey cone. The speaker features a central dust cap, a conical diaphragm, and a flexible rubber surround connecting the cone to the outer basket. Mounting holes are visible around the perimeter of the frame.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The gradient shading on the cone is extremely smooth and uniform, lacking the subtle micro-texture or fiber details typically seen in real paper or polypropylene cones under close inspection. It has a slight 'airbrushed' AI aesthetic.

The mounting holes around the perimeter are inconsistent. Some appear as perfect circles, while others are slightly distorted ovals or irregular blobs. The spacing between them also feels slightly uneven, suggesting geometric instability common in AI generation.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific type of speaker component and rule out misclassification as other circular mechanical parts.
To verify the continuous connection between the cone, the rubber surround, and the metal basket, ensuring no floating elements or fusion artifacts.
To assess the realism of the lighting reflections on the metal frame and the texture fidelity of the cone.

focus_areas: Texture realism of the speaker cone
Boundary integrity between rubber surround and frame
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the symmetry of the mounting holes. In AI images, these often drift from perfect circularity or equal spacing. Also, evaluate if the 'smoothness' of the cone is physically realistic for a macro shot or if it indicates generative smoothing.
